sloka: बहुभी राक्षसैः सार्धं प्रेषयामास रावणः ।तं तु मन्दोदरीपुत्रं कुमारं रणपण्डितम् ।। ५.५८.१२३ ।।।।
transliteration: bahubhī rākṣasaiḥ sārdhaṁ preṣayāmāsa rāvaṇaḥ ।taṁ tu mandodarīputraṁ kumāraṁ raṇapaṇḍitam ।। 5.58.123 ।।।।

translations.english: "When Mandodari's son, an expert in war had risen up to the sky I caught his feet and whirled him round a hundred times and smashed him.
